senses.gloss: (b. h. Polel; cmp. נשק) to touch, join, come in contact; (cmp. חפץ) to desire.—Denom. תְּשׁוּקָה.

units: <cite ref="Yevamot 62b:17">Yeb. 62ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>תשוקתך</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 3:16">Gen. III, 16</cite>) <he>האשה מִשְׁתּוֹקֶקֶת על וכ׳</he> the wife has a desire for her husband when he is about to go on the road; <cite ref="Eruvin 100b">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 32">Yalk. Gen. 32</cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 65a:1">Keth. 65ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>שקויי</he>, <cite ref="Hosea 2:7">Hos. II, 7</cite>) <he>דברים … משתוקקת עליהן וכ׳</he> things which a woman longs for: jewelry.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:1">Num. R. s. 10</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>שוקיו</he>, <cite ref="Song of Songs 5:15">Cant. V, 15</cite>) <he>זה העולם שנ׳ הקב״ה וכ׳</he> that means the world, which the Lord has been longing to create; a. e.
